picks.file: 20120604 Edirne view from the top of the Minaret of Selimiye Mosque Edirne Turkey Panoramic.jpg
picks.what: View from a minaret of the Selimiye Mosque, photograph
picks.why: high-resolution panorama over the old town; Bedesten domes and Üç Şerefeli Mosque recognizable

notes: Only modern photos were found. #2 and #3 (2022) show the Selimiye only as tiny minarets on a far skyline across a field, so the minaret panorama is used instead. Trim cuts the outer edges of a 6:1 panorama.
